topic: Breath series 3b: Box breathing, practice-only version (animated sun round the box, off grid)
build_note: Practice-only box breathing (4-4-4-4, four rounds). Sun travels round a dotted square in an open sky, white and yellow; code in /home/claude/box/reel. David voice, 337 + 38 credits ('One last time.' before round 4). Marimba bed, beat-matched loop (/home/claude/beds/loopbed.py). References copied from the 12 Nov box Reel caption. Matt approved and asked to schedule (18 Nov 2026).
caption:
Do you have a minute? Four rounds of box breathing, paced for you by the sun.

In for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four. Breathe out through your nose or your mouth, whatever feels good.

If a hold feels uncomfortable, shorten it, and lower all four counts together. If you have a heart, lung or blood condition, epilepsy, or are pregnant, check with your doctor before using breath holds.

The practice-only version of our box breathing Reel. The full version, with the research behind it, is on our profile @equal_psychology.

Save this for another time.
